pdf_evidence.quote_en: ORIONDESK AI DETAILED DESIGN / R1.0 CONTROLLED FICTIONAL REFERENCE • OD-AI-DDS-001 057 16 User Interface, Accessibility and Interaction The browser gives analysts a navigable case workspace, provenance-first evidence review and explicit controls for human approval. NORMATIVE INVARIANT A reviewer must be able to inspect source evidence before approval. Figure 16.1 - logical components, boundary contracts and control assertions for user interface, accessibility and interaction. 16.1 Navigation and Information Design 16.1.1 Primary screens The application contains Case Queue, Case Detail, Evidence Viewer, Run Timeline, Review Inbox, Connector Health, Policy Settings and Audit Explorer. Each screen has one primary action and a clear status summary.
